dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible with irregular, serrated light-colored perimeters; the edges show a sharp contrast transition from the dark pelage to a lighter interior, particularly in the central dorsal region where the rings are most defined.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-colored pixel clusters distributed along the lateral flanks; these clusters are smaller than the macro-annuli and appear as solid points without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form a wide-angled obtuse triangle; the spatial distance between the two most anterior rings is roughly 1.5 times the diameter of the largest ring.
